parsed.notes: Limits (min FCCR 2.50:1.00, max leverage 3.50:1.00) are stated for the current Credit Agreement; the excerpt does not explicitly state the limits in force at 2025-09-30, so those are left null (likely the same). Ratios are trailing twelve months, computed on EBITDAR; leverage uses adjusted debt including letters of credit and five-times rent expense, so it is a lease-adjusted gross leverage measure. Interest margins/facility fee are ratings-based and not covenant ratios.
